# Clone Bay
> An unofficial, browser-only EVE Online dashboard for checking several characters at once.

## Overview
Clone Bay is an open-source, purely client-side SPA (Single Page Application) built with Next.js (App Router, static export), React, Tailwind CSS, and Zustand. I use it to keep an eye on several EVE Online characters from one page.

## Architecture & Security (No Backend)
Clone Bay has no backend.
- It uses the EVE SSO PKCE OAuth flow, so no `client_secret` is required.
- Access and refresh tokens are stored in the browser's IndexedDB (`idb-keyval`) as plain JSON, without application-level encryption. A hash-based Content Security Policy, sent as an HTTP header, is the main defence against injected scripts reading them.
- No central database or API exists. All data fetches to the EVE Swagger Interface (ESI) occur directly from the user's browser via Web Workers to prevent UI thread blocking.

## Tech Stack
- Framework: Next.js (Static Export)
- Styling: Tailwind CSS (Strictly forbidding generic shadow/rounded classes in favor of an EVE NeoCom aesthetic)
- State Management: Zustand
- Data Validation: Zod (Strict schema validation for all ESI payloads)

## Data Polling
Polling logic (`esiWorker.ts`) handles HTTP 429 exponential backoffs and gracefully pauses during EVE Online's daily downtime (11:00-11:15 UTC).
